FC600: Forté Guest Arm Chair
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/norix-forte-guest-arm-chair-n700152
Manufacturer page: https://norix.com/product/forte-guest-arm-chairs/
Spec sheets: FC600 Forté Guest Arm Chair, Forté Brochure
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Norix Forté Molded Guest Arm Chair – FC600
Current H1: Norix Forte - Guest Arm Chair - One-Piece Rotationally-Molded Polyethylene – Model FC600
Subtitle: Rotationally Molded Arm Chair with Optional Upholstery for Dining Areas, Dayrooms, Lobbies, and Visitation Rooms
Current subtitle: Norix Furniture Forté Series FC600 Guest Arm Chair - Upholstered or Un-Upholstered
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Norix Forté Guest Arm Chair is a one-piece, rotationally molded arm chair that brings a softer, less institutional look to intensive-use rooms in behavioral healthcare and correctional facilities. It is pitched slightly forward for comfortable sitting at a table, and it pairs with the Forté Café Table.
The lightly textured surface is easy to clean, and tamper-resistant steel-encased nylon glides protect the floor. Molded-in steel threaded inserts let you gang chairs side by side, and a molded-in access port with a threaded screw cap lets you ballast the chair with up to 100 lbs of dry sand or gravel. An optional upholstered shell adds cushioning.
Construction: One-piece, rotationally molded high-impact polyethylene with UV stabilizers and a lightly textured, maintenance-free surface
TruColor Polymer: Fully compounded color for consistent color and durability
Chemical Resistance: Resists blood, vinegar, urine, feces, salt solution, and chlorine solution
Glides: Tamper-resistant steel-encased nylon glides protect floors
Ganging and Ballast: Molded-in steel threaded inserts for optional side-to-side ganging, and a molded-in access port with a threaded screw cap for ballasting
Optional Upholstery: Factory-installed upholstered plywood shell with polyurethane foam on the seat and back, double stitched with concealed staples; it can be removed for cleaning or replacement
Overall Size: 24”W×26.3”D×32.9”H
Seat: 18.1” seat height and 18.6” seat width, with a 26.1” arm height
Weight: 28 lbs
Seat Colors: Twilight, Cove, Sage, Clay, Sand, or Dove; extended colors Citrus, Tranquil, Malibu, Cobalt, Wisteria, LUX Ivory, and LUX Onyx have a 6-piece minimum per color
Static Load Testing: Tested to 750 lbs
Performance Standards: Dynamic drop tested to twice the ANSI/BIFMA X5.4 impact force (250 lbs from 18”)
Flammability Standards (Not Upholstered): California Technical Bulletins 133 and 117; UL 1056; ASTM E1537; NFPA 261; UL 94 HB; BS 7176:2007 high hazard
Flammability Standards (Upholstered): California Technical Bulletin 117, with an optional TB133 upholstery upgrade
Environmental Certification: GREENGUARD and GREENGUARD Gold
Cleaning: Simple Green or a similar cleaner for routine cleaning; bleach and water solutions and hospital-grade disinfectants such as Virex, Wexcide, or Oxivir Five 16 can be used per the manufacturer’s instructions; follow the fabric maker’s instructions for upholstery
Warranty: 10-year limited replacement warranty
Intended Use: Indoor use only
Country of Manufacture: USA
Available Models and Options
FC600 – Not Upholstered: One-piece molded arm chair, 28 lbs
FC600 – Upholstered (COM): Upholstered shell in customer’s own material (1 yard of fabric)
Options: Ganging kit (C011-018), bolt-down kit (C011-026), factory ballasting (50 lbs), and TB133 upholstery upgrade
Installation and Options
Assembly: None required
Ganging: Installation required for ganging plates
Ballast: Can be ballasted on site with up to 100 lbs of dry sand or gravel (not supplied by Norix), or factory ballasted with 50 lbs
[H2] Applications
The Norix Forté Guest Arm Chair suits rooms where people sit at tables or wait, and where furniture has to be durable, easy to clean, and comfortable.
Typical applications include:
Dining areas, dayrooms, and activity rooms in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Lobbies, waiting rooms, and visitation areas
Dayrooms, cafeterias, and visitation rooms in correctional and detention facilities
Transitional housing and shelters
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture, Prison and Detention Furniture, and Transitional Housing Furniture collections for more institutional furniture.
[H2] About Norix Forté Furniture
Norix Forté is a designer series of seating and tables that brings comfort and a less institutional look to intensive-use rooms in behavioral healthcare and correctional facilities. The chairs and molded bases are rotationally molded from high-impact polyethylene with Norix TruColor polymer, and many pieces can be ballasted, bolted down, or ganged together.
The Forté series includes:
Guest Chairs: Guest arm and armless chairs, with or without upholstery
Lounge Chairs: Lounge arm and armless chairs on a molded plinth base or a solid hardwood base, with or without upholstery
Café Tables: A 36” round molded table, 42” and 48” round and 42” square laminate tops, and a 42” square DuoForm top, all on a molded hourglass base
Occasional Tables: 27” square laminate-top tables on a molded or wood base, which can be ganged with lounge chairs as intermediate or corner tables
[H2] About Norix Furniture
Norix manufactures durable furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, police stations, correctional institutions, and residential treatment centers. Explore the full line of Norix Furniture at Anchortex.

Notes and Questions
New series section: the seven Forté products in this batch share an "About Norix Forté Furniture" section based on the Norix Forté brochure and price list. It has no links to individual products. I used it instead of the "About Norix Seating" section because the batch has both chairs and tables. Please review it here; any changes will be applied to all the Forté tabs.
Prices checked: $518.40 (not upholstered) and $892.80 (upholstered, COM) are 80% of the Norix list prices of $648 and $1,116 (compare-at $648 and $1,116). No change.
Upholstered variant: our page sells only the COM (customer’s own material) version. The price list also has fabric grades B through H ($1,146 to $1,329 list). Would you like those as variants? If yes, please give me the SKUs.
Options: the price list shows the ganging kit (C011-018) at $38, the bolt-down plate (C011-026) at $87, factory ballasting (50 lbs) at $84, and the TB133 upholstery upgrade at $89 (list). They are in the text but are not variants. Would you like any of them as variants?
Flammability: the spec sheet lists separate standards for the non-upholstered chair (TB133, TB117, UL 1056, ASTM E1537, NFPA 261, UL 94 HB, BS 7176) and the upholstered chair (TB117, with a TB133 upgrade), so I listed both.
Weight and size match the spec sheet and the worksheet (rows 195-196: 28 / 26.3 / 24 / 32.9).
Images: the 7 current images are kept (6 colors and the color chart; alt text on all is "Norix FC600 Forté Guest Arm Chair"). They already show all 6 standard colors, so I have no new photos to suggest.
Collections: the chair is already in Behavioral Healthcare, Prison and Detention Furniture, Transitional Housing, and Norix Furniture. I added a Transitional Housing Furniture link, since all seven Forté products are in that collection.
Removed: the long old series paragraph and the long old "About Norix Furniture" paragraph; replaced with the new Forté section and the standard paragraph used on all Norix pages.
